description: Mikoyan-Gurevich MiG-17 in camouflage on a raised pad beside the approach road to Aleppo International Airport in the Al-Myassar Jazmati district. Recorded by spottingmode in December 2017 with no airframe linked and separately mapped in OpenStreetMap as a historic aircraft, that node last edited on 17 June 2025. Confirmed visually on Esri imagery of 23 April 2024. No serial is published.
